title: RagRetrievalBench: Local Benchmarking Pipeline for Corpus-Specific Embedding-Model Selection in RAG
description: Code and benchmark artifacts for the paper 'Corpus-specific embedding-model selection for retrieval-augmented generation: A local benchmarking pipeline with query-level uncertainty' (submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). The pipeline builds synthetic queries and LLM-judged relevance judgments from an unlabeled local document collection, evaluates multiple sentence-embedding models under one controlled protocol, estimates query-level bootstrap confidence intervals, and writes dataset-level reports. The release includes the source PDFs, chunked corpora, generated queries, qrels, per-model rankings, raw results and reports for the three corpora of the reported snapshot (education_eng, education_tr, law_tr).
notes: This work was supported by the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Türkiye (TÜBİTAK) under the 1007 Programme, grant number 125G079.
